description: Audora reads the file you uploaded (the file itself, not its name) and attaches it only if it meets the upload spec. A master that is secretly an MP3, or a cover that is not square or is under 3000 pixels, is refused here and the file is removed. Passing here is not the same as being releasable: a release also needs a WAV 16/24-bit 44.1 kHz stereo master and a square RGB JPG cover of 3000–6000 px, which check_readiness reports on.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

name.description: A short name, for an artist image.

name: finalize_upload
title: Check an uploaded file and attach it
